import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { RegisterService, RegisterRequest, RegisterResponse, UsernameCheckResponse } from '../../register.service'; interface Task { description: string; roleName: string; selected: boolean; } @Component({ selector: 'app-register', templateUrl: './register.component.html', styleUrls: ['./register.component.css'] }) export class RegisterComponent implements OnInit { ime: string = ''; username: string = ''; email: string = ''; password: string = ''; confirmPassword: string = ''; tasks: Task[] = [ { description: 'Manage portfolios and transactions', roleName: 'Инвеститор', selected: false }, { description: 'Analyze data trends', roleName: 'Аналитичар', selected: false }, { description: 'Filter and compare current and historic data trends', roleName: 'Аналитичар', selected: false }, { description: 'View current and historic data trends', roleName: 'Обичен корисник', selected: false }, { description: 'Do basic filtering and limited searching', roleName: 'Обичен корисник', selected: false } ]; ulogaNames: string[] = []; response: RegisterResponse | null = null; error: string | null = null; passwordMismatch: boolean = false; usernameExists: boolean = false; passwordWeak: boolean = false; constructor(private registerService: RegisterService) { } ngOnInit(): void { } validatePasswordStrength(): void { const minLength = this.password.length >= 8; const hasNumber = /\d/.test(this.password); const hasUppercase = /[A-Z]/.test(this.password); const hasSpecial = /[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>]/.test(this.password); this.passwordWeak = this.password !== '' && !(minLength && hasNumber && hasUppercase && hasSpecial); } validatePasswords(): void { this.passwordMismatch = this.password !== this.confirmPassword && this.confirmPassword !== ''; } validateUsername(): void { if (this.username.trim() === '') { this.usernameExists = false; return; } this.registerService.checkUsername(this.username).subscribe({ next: (response: UsernameCheckResponse) => { this.usernameExists = response.exists; }, error: (err) => { console.error('Username check failed:', err); this.usernameExists = false; // Assume available if check fails to avoid blocking } }); } updateUlogaNames(): void { const selectedRoles = this.tasks.filter(task => task.selected).map(task => task.roleName); this.ulogaNames = [...new Set(selectedRoles)]; // Unique role names } isFormValid(): boolean { return this.ime.trim() !== '' && this.username.trim() !== '' && !this.usernameExists && this.email.trim() !== '' && this.password.trim() !== '' && !this.passwordWeak && this.confirmPassword.trim() !== '' && !this.passwordMismatch && this.ulogaNames.length > 0; } register(): void { if (!this.isFormValid()) { this.error = 'Please fill all fields correctly and select at least one task.'; return; } const request: RegisterRequest = { ime: this.ime, username: this.username, email: this.email, password: this.password, confirmPassword: this.confirmPassword, ulogaNames: this.ulogaNames }; this.registerService.register(request).subscribe({ next: (response) => { this.response = response; this.error = null; // Reset form this.ime = ''; this.username = ''; this.email = ''; this.password = ''; this.confirmPassword = ''; this.tasks.forEach(task => task.selected = false); this.ulogaNames = []; this.passwordMismatch = false; this.usernameExists = false; this.passwordWeak = false; }, error: (err) => { this.response = null; this.error = err.error?.message || 'Registration failed'; } }); } }
